note: Respectful, informational pieces only. Nothing here was invented. Live fetch adds RNZ tikanga, news and The Lodge / CultProof podcasts when a source is reachable. Matching cult stories already in feed.json are tagged in too.

items.t: Te Whakatōhea mourns pou tikanga Dr Te Riaki Amoamo
items.s: For more than 60 years, Dr Te Riaki Amoamo passed on the reo, whakapapa and tikanga of Te Whakatōhea so younger generations could stand and speak for their people.

items.t: Māori Queen makes historic visit to Tai Rāwhiti
items.s: The Poukai is an annual circuit of visits by Te Arikinui to marae associated with the Kiingitanga.

items.t: Ngāi Tūhoe mourns treasured son Tā Pou Temara
items.s: The celebrated academic, author, historian and teacher — a leading voice in tikanga, reo and history — returned to Mataatua marae, to his hapū Te Urewera.

items.t: What's the difference between a cult and a high-control group?
items.s: RNZ’s Phil Vine and expert guides from the Cult Chat podcast discuss how to recognise a cult or high-control group, what they do, and what it can take to leave one.
An RNZ podcast series in which Phil Vine speaks with people who have left high-control groups, including Gloriavale, Falun Gong and Exclusive Brethren, with context from cult experts.
